args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out, and the service now reports healthy (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer was paged.
